create_Config: create a Config dataclass instance with nested Input, Output, and mode-specific config objects for human pose estimation
create_Input: create an Input dataclass to specify frame ranges, sample interval, and trajectory directories for pose data
create_PreprocessFrameConfig: create a PreprocessFrameConfig dataclass to configure dataset name, VRS path, and frame extraction options
create_BBoxConfig: create a BBoxConfig dataclass to configure the detector model, human dimensions, and bounding box thresholds
create_PoseEstimationConfig: create a PoseEstimationConfig dataclass to specify pose model config paths and checkpoint files
